stories.title: Russia releases detained U.S. Marine Robert Gilman after four years
new_facts: Trump secured release of ex-US Marine Robert Gilman, pardoned by Putin after 4 years.
Gilman, 32, arrested Jan 2022 en route to English-teaching job in Moldova; father disputes charges.
Gilman held exactly 1,666 days; Fox frames release as part of a prisoner exchange.
Gilman was in a dissociative stupor for 47 days before being flown out of Russia.
stories.line: Russia released former U.S. Marine Robert Gilman after nearly four years of detention on disputed charges.

stories.title: UK summer on pace for record heat as water shortages spread
new_facts: 10,000+ homes without water; record wildfires last month; all England under amber heat health alert.
Met Office issued second-ever extreme heat warning; 38C temperatures flagged; ghost village and dry reservoirs reported.
Only average August conditions needed to break record set just last year, per Met Office.
stories.line: UK summer 2026 tracking toward record heat; thousands lose water access as drought conditions intensify.

stories.title: OpenAI executive Lightcap departs to launch AI startup
new_facts: Longtime OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap is leaving the company amid ongoing shakeup.
Lightcap, formerly COO then special projects lead, says he is leaving "to start something new".
Trajectory, founded by ex-DeepMind/Apple/OpenAI/Meta staffers, raised $40M from Sequoia at $300M valuation.
stories.line: OpenAI's former chief operating officer is leaving to start a new AI company backed by $40 million in funding.

stories.title: University of Michigan switches first-semester freshmen to pass/fail grading
new_facts: University of Michigan will make first-semester grades pass or fail to support student mental health.
School announced on Tuesday; goal is to curb mental health crisis among college-aged individuals.
Policy takes effect fall 2027; transcripts will record only whether credit was earned.
stories.line: University of Michigan will give first-semester freshmen pass/fail grades instead of letter grades to reduce mental health pressure.
